title: Inertial confinement of a magnetically driven implosion (ICF confinement time)
description: Ellison benchmark 4. A magnetically driven implosion in which the inertial confinement time of the stagnated fuel column is directly measured. The simulation must reproduce the stagnation scalars (minimum fuel radius, peak fuel density) and, ultimately, the confinement time. Stated scalars below are extracted faithfully; the confinement-time result is left pending digitization for #121 (no fabricated points).
